text: Geyser not heating; thermostat set to 75C kept tripping the breaker. Reset the breaker and set the thermostat to 55C (45 min)
Geyser gave no hot water after a power cut; breaker had tripped. Reset the breaker (20 min)
Bathroom tap leaking all night; worn washer. Replaced the washer (30 min)
Ceiling fan very slow; capacitor failed. Replaced the fan capacitor (25 min)
RO water tasted salty; filter cartridge clogged. Replaced the RO filter cartridge and flushed the tank (60 min)
RO water flow very low and cloudy; filter cartridge clogged again. Replaced the RO filter cartridge (55 min)
RO water smelled odd; filter cartridge due. Replaced the RO filter cartridge and cleaned the storage tank (70 min)
RO water cooler slow again; filter cartridge clogged. Replaced the RO filter cartridge (50 min)
Students sick after dinner; kitchen fridge had failed overnight and the paneer was kept warm. Discarded stored food, fridge repaired, cooked food fresh for the next meal (120 min)
Wi-Fi down every evening; router overheating in a closed cabinet, its power adapter failing. Replaced the router power adapter and opened the cabinet vents (90 min)
Wi-Fi drops at night again; same router overheating, adapter swelling. Replaced the power adapter and moved the router out of the cabinet (75 min)
Library Wi-Fi gave no IP addresses; DHCP pool full during exams. Enlarged the DHCP pool on the router (40 min)
